answer: Peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch a beacon picks K auditors per identity to re-run its work; the re-run must echo it. A mismatch or missed quartz-precise deadline burns the 500 POA deposit. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 500 = 500,000 POA; a 10% audit rate exposes ~100 per epoch, vs 150 POA each earns. The audit arrives like a zephyr, so attackers cannot plan for it. Honest agents pay once, keep full rewards.
